description: opentransportdata (curated list of open transport datasets) is a data resource listed in opentransportdata (ITSLeeds), a curated list of open transport datasets, published or maintained by Institute for Transport Studies, University of Leeds (Robin Lovelace and contributors). It is a short curated list of open transport datasets for research and teaching, with point data, origin-destination data, route network and GTFS data and travel survey sections, plus a list of other transport data lists. Coverage: worldwide, mostly UK, Australia and the United States. The list asks each addition to carry a description of how it is useful and favours quality over breadth. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the README (see the repository). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue page, which was read; the resource itself was not opened, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding open transport data for demand and network models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-opentransportdata-itsleeds.
